name: Rocket Pool rETH Staking
description: Stake ETH into Rocket Pool's decentralised node network and receive rETH, a value-accruing liquid staking token. No 32-ETH minimum, no node to run.
use_case: Agent has idle ETH. Deposits into Rocket Pool → receives rETH that appreciates vs ETH as staking rewards accrue. Fully decentralised validator set, redeemable on secondary markets any time.

verification.criteria: Tx target is RocketDepositPool, function deposit() (payable). Post-tx rETH.balanceOf(agent) increased.
